title: Daniel Lain
text: Hello, my name is Daniel Lain and I study Industrial Engineering & Operations Analytics at the University of Arkansas. I am a passionate and dedicated student who strives to contribute to a dynamic work space, promoting work-centric values and a positive attitude. On campus, I am a Peer Mentor for the College of Engineering, where I instruct incoming freshman with advice on how to be successful during their first-year experience. After graduation, I plan to grow my professional career by working in industrial related companies.
